questions.question: Describe the architecture of the multi-tenant platform solution you built at Ring that handled 1.4 million transactions per second. What were the key scaling and reliability decisions?
You mention achieving approximately 7% performance improvement and $10 million in IMR savings. How did you identify the bottlenecks, validate the changes, and measure the resulting impact?
What was your role in migrating nearly 400 internal customers, and how did you plan the migration to improve availability and security while minimizing disruption?
Walk us through a CI/CD pipeline you have designed or significantly improved using Jenkins. How did you handle testing, artifact management, deployment controls, and rollback?
This role requires operating highly available Linux-based services. How have you monitored, troubleshot, and resolved production issues on Linux systems?

Tell us about the geo-distributed monitoring solution you built for vCloud Air. Which open-source technologies did you use, and how did the design handle real-time monitoring across distributed systems?
How have you used tools such as Zabbix, Jenkins, Docker, or VMware platforms to improve operational efficiency, observability, or reliability?
Describe a high-severity production incident involving a scalable backend service. How did you diagnose the issue, communicate with stakeholders, mitigate customer impact, and prevent recurrence?
What is your approach to designing secure multi-tenant services, particularly around tenant isolation, access control, secrets management, and auditability?

You have worked through complete SDLC cycles and Agile delivery. How did you collaborate with product owners, QA, and other engineering teams to take one of your major projects from initial requirements through production release?
